correctness.rationale: Every coprime binary homogeneous pair of even degrees 2,4,6 was tested (24,384,6144 pairs), including infinity; Hasse jets characterize exact local indices at all geometric points. The exact code finds 0,0,72 tame maps and confirms two disjoint 36-map PGL2 source/target orbits; independent symbolic code checks degrees 2 and 4 exhaustively and all 72 degree-6 members. Branch values and Riemann-Hurwitz are directly confirmed.
